title: trichophorum evadens
intro: Trichophorum evadens, commonly known as cotton grass, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
